sources.snippet: Qwen3-ASR-.6B Albanian This is a fine-tuned variant of Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-.6B for Albanian (sq / Shqip) automatic speech recognition. It is trained on ~728 hours of carefully curated Albanian audio + transcripts. Intended use ASR / transcription for Albanian speech (general-purpose). Works best on clean speech audio (mono, 16 kHz) with transcripts matching the dataset conventions. Limitations ...

sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR: Qwen3-ASR is an open-source series of ASR ...
sources.snippet: The Qwen3-ASR family includes Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and Qwen3-ASR-.6B, which support language identification and ASR for 52 languages and dialects. Both leverage large-scale speech training data and the strong audio understanding capability of their foundation model, Qwen3-Omni.
